subject: general
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don't find any error, mark 'No error' as your answer.

She rarely approached nobody / to talk about the problems / that she was facing.
solution:
The correct answer is "**She rarely approached nobody**".

• The use of a double negative ("rarely" and "nobody") creates a positive statement, meaning the sentence is saying that she approached somebody often.
